packageRules.description: flake.nix does not pin the inputs to a rev, so Renovate moves them only through lock file maintenance (nix flake update). Keep that apart from Cargo.lock, so that a broken nixos-unstable does not hold back the crates
The Nix build gets the toolchain from rust-overlay, which knows a release only once flake.lock is past it: waiting 8 days leaves room for one weekly flake.lock update in between
typst, typst-pdf and typst-assets only compile against the same release
Semver-compatible, also on 0.x. CI builds, lints and tests every PR before anything merges
Minor bumps are compatible only from 1.0 on
